items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: I'm holding Spoon with one hand and Emmett Berry with the other hand.

ctx.x: Well when it was over Jimmy Witherspoon stepped off the band stand and Sir Charles was standing in the way. He says, get out of the way.

So and so and so on. So Sir Charles says, go around me, so and so and so forth. Well then they, it's beginning to cussing and fighting and from somewhere Emmett Berry reached over with his trumpet and hit Spoon right on the head.
